kp6:1.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
kp6:1.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
kp6:1.3: may the minds of all those beings be happy,
kp6:1.4: and may they listen carefully to what is said.
kp6:2.1: Therefore, all of you beings, be attentive,
kp6:2.2: be friendly towards this generation of men,
kp6:2.3: they who bring offerings by day and by night,
kp6:2.4: as they are heedful please protect them.
kp6:3.1: Whatever riches there are - here or hereafter
kp6:3.2: or in the heavens - that excellent treasure
kp6:3.3: is not equal unto the Realised One -
kp6:3.4: this excellent treasure is in the Buddha:
kp6:3.5: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:4.2: that which the concentrated Sakyan sage attained -
kp6:4.3: there is nothing that is equal to the Dhamma -
kp6:4.4: this excellent treasure is in the Dhamma:
kp6:4.5: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:5.1: That which the great Buddha praised as being pure -
kp6:5.2: the concentration said to have immediate (result) -
kp6:5.3: no equal to that concentration is found -
kp6:5.4: this excellent treasure is in the Dhamma:
kp6:5.5: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:6.1: Those eight individuals praised by the good -
kp6:6.2: there are these four pairs (of persons) -
kp6:6.3: those disciples of the Happy One are worthy of gifts,
kp6:6.4: those things that have been given to them have great fruit -
kp6:6.5: this excellent treasure is in the Sangha:
kp6:6.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:7.1: Those who have firm minds that are devoted to
kp6:7.2: Gotama’s teaching, being free from sense desire -
kp6:7.3: having attained and entered the deathless -
kp6:7.4: are enjoying the stillness, obtained for free -
kp6:7.5: this excellent treasure is in the Sangha:
kp6:7.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:8.1: Just as a locking post stuck fast in the earth
kp6:8.2: does not waver on account of the four winds,
kp6:8.3: just like this, I say, is the person who is true,
kp6:8.4: the one who sees the noble truths completely -
kp6:8.5: this excellent treasure is in the Sangha:
kp6:8.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:9.1: Those who clearly distinguish the noble truths,
kp6:9.2: which have been well preached by the one with great wisdom,
kp6:9.3: no matter how great they become in heedlessness
kp6:9.4: still they do not take up an eighth existence -
kp6:9.5: this excellent treasure is in the Sangha:
kp6:9.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:10.1: Together with his attainment of seeing (Emancipation)
kp6:10.2: there are three things that are given up:
kp6:10.4: whatever (grasping at) virtue and practices there is.
kp6:11.1: He is free from (rebirth in) the four lower worlds,
kp6:11.2: and he is incapable of the six great crimes -
kp6:11.3: this excellent treasure is in the Sangha:
kp6:11.4: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:12.2: by way of body, speech, or mind,
kp6:12.3: he is incapable of covering it up:
kp6:12.4: this incapacity is said of one who has seen the state (of peace) -
kp6:12.5: this excellent treasure is in the Sangha:
kp6:12.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:13.1: Just like a tall woodland tree crowned with flowers
kp6:13.2: in the summer months, in the early summer,
kp6:13.3: just like this he preached the Dhamma which is best,
kp6:13.4: which goes to Emancipation, the highest benefit -
kp6:13.5: this excellent treasure is in the Buddha:
kp6:13.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:14.1: The best one, knowing the best, gave the best, brought the best,
kp6:14.2: he preached the best Dhamma, which is unsurpassed -
kp6:14.3: this excellent treasure is in the Buddha:
kp6:14.4: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:15.1: The old is destroyed, and nothing new is produced,
kp6:15.2: their minds are unexcited by future rebirth,
kp6:15.3: they have destroyed the seeds, and have no desire for growth,
kp6:15.4: the wise are still, just as this lamp (is still) -
kp6:15.5: this excellent treasure is in the Sangha:
kp6:15.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
kp6:16.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
kp6:16.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
kp6:16.3: o we (all) revere the realised Buddha who is
kp6:16.4: honoured by gods and men - may there be safety!
kp6:17.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
kp6:17.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
kp6:17.3: o we (all) revere the realised Dhamma which is
kp6:17.4: honoured by gods and men - may there be safety!
kp6:18.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
kp6:18.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
kp6:18.3: o we (all) revere the realised Sangha which is
kp6:18.4: honoured by gods and men - may there be safety!
